stages.name: Reconnaissance
stages.description: Research and selection of potential targets.

stages.name: Weaponization
stages.description: Preparation of a payload for delivery to a target.

stages.name: Delivery
stages.description: Transfer of the payload into the targeted environment.

stages.name: Exploitation
stages.description: Triggering code or taking advantage of a weakness on the target.

stages.name: Installation
stages.description: Establishing a foothold on a target system.

stages.name: Command and Control
stages.description: Establishing communications used to control compromised systems.

stages.name: Actions on Objectives
stages.description: Carrying out the objectives of the intrusion, such as stealing data.
